interpretation: Readiness categories are engineering gaps for the current bounded generic route, not benchmark scores or claims that tasks are impossible.
No additional task is certified runnable based solely on Dockerfile names, file suffixes or a public description.
Public task.toml descriptions support manual workflow grouping; filename/layout heuristics identify areas to inspect, not complete runtime inventories.
Only the controller-reported headless pilot success is acknowledged; later pilot results must be joined from their independently inspected bounded receipts.

Current full indexing requires nonempty exact source inputs, at most64 index files, complete native adapter coverage, qualified symbols and source byte bounds. Metadata cannot establish these runtime properties.
The adapter declares Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/JSX/TSX and JSON/Markdown frontends; language support alone does not establish qualified symbol coverage, compatible semantics or admission.
The 840-second work budget differs from native allowances on39 longer and2 shorter tasks. Larger suite results must retain per-task budgets and disclose modifications.
No empty-source task should acquire fabricated source facts. Data, binaries, generated files and external inputs require declared representations and separately scoped capabilities.
After the three selected pilots,85 other tasks still need their own qualification; this report does not execute or score them.
recommended_workstreams: Add an honest empty-source planning/index representation, preserving absence of source proof authority.
Separate exact immutable task input inventory from the subset qualified for source-symbol indexing; retain explicit unsupported/data coverage and source hashes.
Introduce explicit build, dependency-installation, command execution and generated-artifact stages with bounded permissions and task-native budget accounting.
Add separately authorized service/VM, Git metadata and alternative repository-root profiles.
Qualify public-test provenance boundaries before tasks whose original image copies files from tests trees.
Run matched baselines and no-index ablations on each qualified profile while preserving full recorded model usage and failed-attempt costs.
